page.notes: The left edge of the page is cropped, so the first words of several lines are fragments (e.g. "am", "sse", "a eum", "fficacissimum", "iè", "on", "iatenus", "re") and are transcribed as visible. Uncertain: "lnuendum" (line 3), "fficacissimum", "æorum"-type initial letters at the left edge, "lah." (reference, cropped), "r." (cropped word before "Exod."). The sentence "ut zelare facient ipsum" is partly cut at the edge. Printing errors left as printed: "effet", "scicbant", "concuquenti". Long s has been written as plain s throughout.
